prompt.style: Instrumental bass-led funk, 124 BPM, 4/4, a fast melodic fingerstyle bass riff as the lead instrument, tight dry drums with crisp ghost notes, sparse electric piano chords, organ swells, punchy unison hits, dry compressed vintage mix, joyful, no vocals
prompt.structure:
[Instrumental]
[Intro: 3 bars, electric piano chords and a closed hi-hat, waiting]
[Verse: 7 bars, the melodic bass riff takes the lead over a tight dry groove]
[Pre-Chorus: 6 bars, organ swells under the bass, building]
[Chorus: 6 bars, the lift, the bass riff climbs into its fastest run, the whole band hits with it]
[Break: 9 bars, drop back to bass and drums, keep the groove]
[Verse: 8 bars, the riff returns, playful, leave space]
[Build: 8 bars, a key change up, rising]
[Outro: 3 bars, one big unison hit, button ending]
[End]
prompt.notes: Ask for 1:36. If it comes back longer (Suno often makes two minutes or more), use it anyway: Line up puts its biggest lift on 'Agent makes it', corrects its tempo, and ends it with the film. The style describes the sound asked for (a dry funk band led by a fast, melodic bass line) in its own words: generators refuse song and band names.
